title: Excellent experience
text: Great experience, wonderful energy and well worth the trip. Everyone was so friendly! Great communication too. Highly recommend.
author: 769susannahw

title: Amazing Tour of Montserrat and Horse-riding
text: Carlos was a great guide and the horse-riding was absolutely amazing. Loved every minute! Laura, the instructor, was amazing with the horses and was very fun.
author: J6530IVtomb

title: 100% Recommend
text: The tour was wonderful. Laura was great at showing how to ride the horses and it was very fun. Carlos gave a great tour of Montserrat. The tour was very organised and ran very smoothly.
author: 20niamhk

title: Best tour ever !
text: This tour was one of the highlights of our trip! The horseback riding with the mountains in the background was truly special. Our guide, Bosco, was amazing—he shared the history of Monserrate in such an engaging way that made the experience even more memorable. Highly recommend!!
author: Mark R

title: Lovely day out
text: Bosco was knowledgeable and approachable.  The horse riding was very relaxing.  Very suitable for inexperienced riders.  Time at top a bit rushed as bus driver got a bit lost on way up
author: carmelanderson

title: Wonderful Experience!
text: Roger was a great tour and is very knowledgeable about Montserrat and the surrounding areas. Laura was very helpful with the horses and set us up for a beautiful ride. The views on the trail and from the monastery were incredible. 10/10, would book again!
author: shelbya159

title: Monastery at Montserrat
text: Great trip and experience horse back riding and visiting the monastery in Montserrat. Lucas was a great guide that offered a lot of fun info and insight to the trip.
author: austinv973

title: Awesome horseback riding and Montserrat tour
text: Awesome tour by Roger who was our guide, Oscar and Rafa the drivers, and Laura who took us on the beautiful ride with the horses. Thank you guys. Highly recommend!
author: piotrmaksymiliank

title: Horse riding and Montserrat
text:
5 Stars
Well organised, friendly guide and beautiful horse riding experience (even for someone with no experience). Roger, Laura, Rafa and Oscar - all are doing a great job! Highly recommended!
author: Klaudia V

title: Beautiful experience
text: The tour was great! As an experienced rider, I found the horseback riding part a bit too easy as it was just a walk. However, the scenery more than made up for it. The views were absolutely stunning! Montserrat is such a beautiful and unique place, and our guide Katia took excellent care of us throughout the experience.
author: OliviaG1636
